Electroharmonix splits each word into single letters, with open-handed curves and a sizable x-height. And Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi gives it a modern partner, its crayon-tall lowercase strokes and cut-back terminals leaving big gaps.

Terminals on Noto Sans Gurmukhi point outward like a pair of tongs, while its ascenders barely clear the x-height. Noto Sans Gurmukhi stays clean and readable, giving Electroharmonix's gapped, commanding letters a strong contrast.
